text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder has invited me to visit<n>an exhibition
on Umamusume history<n>together.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
So this is how passion for racing gets<n>passed
down.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The walls are lined with a plethora of<n>items, from
photos of past races to<n>the cleats legendary
Umamusume<n>wore early in their careers. Even
letters to their trainers are on display.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Lessons of the past lead us to new<n>discoveries.
That rings so true as I<n>walk through these halls.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The passion and grit from these<n>runners come
across loud and clear<n>from within each display.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I must do all of them proud.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
As a fellow Umamusume who carries<n>on their
legacy, Grass Wonder seems<n>to enjoy exploring
this display of past<n>racers' experiences.

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text:
This one's face is cute, but she ain't<n>exactly got
curves. I've seen better.<n>Fifty-seven points!

text_block_list.name: Man B
text_block_list.text:
Pretty generous if you ask me. Look<n>how desperate
she looks racing in<n>this photo. Forty-three points,
tops!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Huh... It seems some people just<n>can't keep their
voices down.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The two offenders receive many<n>unpleasant
glances from the other<n>visitors, but they seem
unwilling to<n>turn it down a notch.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I'll be right back.
choice_data_list: Be careful not to provoke them, okay?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hehe, thank you for your concern.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: But there are lines that should never<n>be crossed.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder briskly walks up to the<n>men and
taps them on their<n>shoulders.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Might I ask what the two of you have<n>come here to
do?

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
If that is the only manner of<n>evaluation you care to
give these<n>runners, then perhaps this isn't the<n>right
place for you.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
You're disturbing those of us who<n>came here to
enjoy history. So would<n>you please see yourselves
out the<n>door... And I mean now.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Her cold and straightforward tone<n>must have
terrified the two men,<n>because they both rush out
the door<n>in a flash.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Perhaps that was... excessive of me.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
But I simply couldn't allow them to<n>continue like
that.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She smiles softly, but I can tell that<n>behind her
gentle demeanor there lies<n>a strong sense of
conviction.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She approaches the men and says,<n>"May I have a
word?"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Your loud and rude remarks are<n>disturbing the
guests and staff.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Personally, I don't think that kind of<n>talk is
appropriate for this<n>establishment. Am I wrong?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
After a stern talking-to, the men must<n>have noticed
all the other onlookers,<n>because they awkwardly
begin<n>making for the exit.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I don't like to judge others for their<n>personal
tastes, but...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I just couldn't let their utter<n>disrespect for history
slide.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Behind Grass Wonder's rueful smile,<n>I can see she
harbors a powerful<n>respect for her Umamusume
forebears.
